summary: A group save sending a revision a group read answered, after the record moved on, is a conflict that carries the current revision.

then.note: The group read answered "6"; another save of a different group made it "7" before this one. The host compares against the record's revision, not the group's: a change to another group is still a change to the record. The answer carries "7", and the component keeps what the person typed and reads the record again at it.
